property_summary: For any payable call to go() that forwards ETH to an external target which may accept the funds, the contract C MUST preserve owner (owner stays the deployer) after go() completes; the mutant replaces the final transfer with resetting owner, so owner can change to zero address for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace the final transfer to owner with a direct assignment to owner (no transfer), changing owner state value observed after go().
